description:
G0946 2x Dead self-sown trees and 1x Sycamore with Sooty Bark Disease in group along rear garden boundary - Fell.

G9520 2x Trees within Group - Reduce/prune 1x Bay and 1x Laurel as a single crown to form tidy manageable bush form and allow better light to building. Reduce height from 4m to 2m and reduce by 1-2m lateral pruning to shape.

T0785 Robinia - Crown Clean, remove major deadwood / snags

T0937 Oak - Crown Clean, remove major deadwood

T0952 Sycamore - Crown Clean, remove major deadwood

T0949 Bay - Reduce and reshape to manage size in proximity to building and allow more light. Reduce height from 4m to 2.5m, reduce spread from 4m to 2m all aspects.

T0950 Ash - Prune/reduce back from building by approximately 2m. Reduce height from approximately 8m to 6m and reduce spread on Northern aspect from approximately 4m to 2m.

T9525 Yellow False Acacia – Sever Ivy from base to a height of 2m.

T9528 Sycamore - Crown Clean, remove major deadwood

T9524 Sycamore - Pollard from 12m to approx 7-8m, due to sub dominant stem defect and canopy dominance. 

T0947 Oak - Crown Clean, remove major deadwood
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The proposed work is to be carried out to British Standard 3998 (2010) Tree Work Recommendations, by a reputable tree surgeon to the satisfaction of the Tree Preservation Officer who should be informed of the date of commencement of work.
